step1_analysis.description: A passive AC coupling network typically used between RF amplifier stages to block DC offsets while passing high-frequency signals. It models the inter-stage coupling and parasitic capacitances to evaluate the tradeoff between bandwidth and midband loss as discussed in the paper.

paper_reference.title: DC-Coupled IF Stage Design for a 900-MHz ISM Receiver

midband_loss.description: Insertion loss of the AC coupling network in the passband.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the voltage divider of coupling capacitors and load/bias resistors. With Cc=100pF and C2=100pF, impedance is low at 10MHz, resulting in minimal loss.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Large coupling capacitors (100pF) provide very low impedance at RF/IF frequencies, minimizing midband loss.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_c = 1 / (2 * pi * R * C). With R~1k and C~50pF (series combination of C2 and Cc), f_c is around 3MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by the RC time constant of the coupling capacitors and the bias/load resistors.

upper_cutoff_frequency.description: Low-pass -3dB corner frequency due to parasitics.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by parasitic capacitance C1 (1pF) and load resistor RL1 (1k). f_c = 1 / (2 * pi * 1k * 1pF) = 159MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Parasitic capacitance to ground creates a low-pass filter effect at very high frequencies.

coupling_capacitance.description: Value of the coupling capacitor used in the network.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper explicitly mentions 100 pF for the coupling capacitor.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure the AC response (midband loss, lower and upper cutoff frequencies) and transient response of the AC coupling network.
step3_testbench.spice:
* AC Coupling Network Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param R_b=10k R_L1=1k C_c=100p C_2=100p C_1=1p

* DUT
Rb N1 Vbias {R_b}
RL1 N0 Vo1 {R_L1}
Cc N0 N1 {C_c}
C2 N1 Vin2 {C_2}
C1 N0 GND {C_1}

* Sources
VVO1 Vo1 0 DC 1.8
VVBIAS Vbias 0 DC 0.75
VVIN2 Vin2 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.1 10MEG 0 0)

.control
* AC Analysis
ac dec 100 10k 10G
let gain_n0 = vdb(N0)
let gain_n1 = vdb(N1)

meas ac midband_gain_n0 find gain_n0 at=10MEG
meas ac max_gain_n0 max gain_n0
let f3db_target = max_gain_n0 - 3
meas ac f3db_lower when gain_n0=f3db_target rise=1
meas ac f3db_upper when gain_n0=f3db_target fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 100p 200n
meas tran v_max_n0 max v(N0)
meas tran v_min_n0 min v(N0)
let v_pp_n0 = v_max_n0 - v_min_n0
print v_pp_n0

quit
.endc
